title: "Welcome to my Portfolio"
---

Hello my name is Chidera Orizu, i’m a senior majoring in Bioinformatics with a Data Science minor, and I’m most interested in the places where computation and biology meet. Whether it’s analyzing large datasets, building small tools to make research easier, or exploring how code can reveal patterns in living systems, I enjoy work that helps make complex biological questions clearer.

This portfolio highlights projects that reflect who I am as a learner and a researcher: curious, detail-oriented, and always trying to connect the technical side of things back to real biological meaning. You’ll find a mix of data analyses, coding work, and biology-focused projects here  all things I’ve built as I figure out the kind of scientist I want to become.

Thanks for taking a look around.
